config.design: 144 heldout copy/next/previous prompts in month/number domains. Add alpha times native receiver projected effective input value of layer14 head4 at final attention write; alphas+/-0.025,+/-0.05,+/-0.1,0. Shared seed669 random unit direction scaled to each receiver value norm at+/-0.05. Full downstream computation. No selection/tuning.
config.limitations: Local finite probes of native contexts; random control is one direction, not null distribution. Coefficient strengths fixed, vector norms vary across inputs. Current/next/previous selected logits and margins, not full task algorithm.
